newsitem.title: FINLAND: Four die in Macedonia helicopter crash.
newsitem.headline: Four die in Macedonia helicopter crash.

text.p: Three Finnish United Nations peacekeepers and a Canadian civilian helicopter pilot were killed when their helicopter crashed into a lake in Macedonia on Saturday, the Finnish STT news agency reported.
The agency said all three passengers and the pilot were killed when the helicopter plunged into a lake in Mavrovo, a national park south of the capital, Skopje. Two bodies have been recovered.
The Finns were among 360 engaged in a U.N. operation with the pan-Nordic battalion, STT quoted the Finnish defence ministry's U.N. office as saying.
